Bug_Details: this == null is always false, this != null is always true The boolean expression this != null always returns true and similarly this == null always returns false.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the line 'if (this == null) {... }' in the showBug() method. The bug occurs because the 'this' keyword always refers to the current object, and therefore it can never be null. The condition 'this == null' will always evaluate to false, and the code inside the if-statement will never be executed.
